lab.text: Proposed: Parlor Lab — admin tunables & sandbox

labHow.text:
How Lab works

• Turn on: open any page with ?lab=1 (remembered) or tap the Parlor wordmark 7 times. ?lab=0 turns it off.
• One registry, site/js/lab.js: every knob is tune('drag.threshold') with today's constant as its default. Overrides live in localStorage parlor.lab.v1, never in the Settings or Stats files.
• Isolated: /lab/ is a sandbox with fixed deals, no saves, no stats, no analytics. 'Apply to my games' is a separate switch, and the game bar shows a LAB chip while it's on.
• Promote a change: Export → paste the JSON into a PR. Colour and type edits map 1:1 to design/tokens.json.
• Not a lock: it's a static site, so anyone who knows the flag can open it. Keep nothing private behind it.

replayQs.text:
Decided

• Moves = card moves on the board at the win, auto-homes included (102 in the sample, same as today's code).
• Undo, hints and restart are free and don't touch the streak.
• Locked in at the win: first solve is the record (time, moves, replay code). Playing again is practice.
• Replay of an unsolved Daily is locked. Watching anyway = that day can't count toward the streak; a later solve shows 'Watched first'.
• Practice button renamed 'Play again', so 'Replay' only means watching.
